cpu_cores.description_en: The number of CPU cores used
cpu_cores.title: 使用了多少个cpu core

cpu_sec.description_en: The total CPU time consumed in seconds
cpu_sec.title: 消耗的cpu总时间（秒）

elapsed_milli.description_en: The SQL query running time in milliseconds
elapsed_milli.title: SQL执行时间（毫秒）

keys.description_en: The names of the columns in the SQL result. The keys correspond one-to-one with the fields in the SELECT statement

keys.title: SQL结果对应的column名称，这里的keys和select中的字段是一一对应的。

processed_rows.description_en: The number of raw data rows processed
processed_rows.title: 处理的原始数据行数

progress.description_en:
Indicates whether the SQL result is accurate. Valid values are:

Complete: The result is accurate.

Incomplete: The result is not accurate
progress.description_zh:
SQL结果是否精确，它可以为以下两个值: 
Complete (表示结果精确)
Incomplete (表示结果不精确)
progress.title: SQL结果是否精确，它可以为以下两个值: ● Complete (表示结果精确) ● Incomplete (表示结果不精确)

result_rows.description_en: The total number of rows in the result. When you read the results, the offset value must not exceed this value
result_rows.description_zh: 结果总行数。读取结果是，offset值不应该超过这个值
result_rows.title: 结果总行数。读取结果是，offset值不应该超过这个值。

error_code.description_en: If the SQL query fails to execute, this parameter contains the specific error code
error_code.description_zh: SQL执行失败后，error_code中包含了具体的错误码
error_code.title: SQL执行失败后，error_code中包含了具体的错误码

error_message.description_en: If the SQL query fails to execute, this parameter contains the specific error message
error_message.description_zh: SQL执行失败后，error_message中包含了具体的错误信息
error_message.title: SQL执行失败后，error_message中包含了具体的错误信息

id.description_en: The ID of the asynchronous SQL query
id.title: 异步SQL的ID

rows.description_en: The SQL result. Each element in the array is also an array that corresponds to a specific row of the result
rows.description_zh: SQL结果。array中的每个元素也是数组，对应具体的一行结果
rows.title: SQL结果。array中的每个元素也是数组，对应具体的一行结果。

state.description_en:
The current execution state of the asynchronous SQL query. Valid values are:

RUNNING

FINISHED

FAILED

CANCELLED

RUNNING is a temporary state that indicates the SQL query is still running. You can read the results only when the state is FINISHED. The error_code and error_message parameters are valid only when the state is FAILED
state.description_zh:
异步SQL的当前执行状态，可以为以下三个状态: 
RUNNING
FINISHED
FAILED
CANCELLED

其中，RUNNING是临时状态, 表示SQL还在执行过程中。仅当状态为FINISHED时，才表示请求执行成功，可以读取结果了。另外，只有状态为FAILED时，返回结果中的error_code和error_message才有意义
state.title: 异步SQL的当前执行状态，可以为以下三个状态: ● RUNNING ● FINISHED ● FAILED ● CANCELLED 其中，RUNNING是临时状态, 表示SQL还在执行过程中。仅当状态为FINISHED时，才表示请求执行成功，可以读取结果了。

fields.help_en: The maximum running time for the request in milliseconds. Maximum value: 600,000 (10 minutes). Default value: 600,000
fields.help_zh: 允许请求执行的最大时间（单位毫秒），当前设置的允许最大执行时间不得超过600000（即10分钟），默认值为600000
fields.name: max_run_time

fields.help_en: Specifies whether to enable enhanced SQL. The default value is false
fields.name: power_sql

parameters.help_en: The start of the query time range. This time is the log time specified when the log was written. The time range defined by the from and to parameters is left-inclusive and right-exclusive. This means the time range includes the start time but excludes the end time. If the from and to values are the same, the time range is invalid and the function returns an error. The value is a UNIX timestamp in seconds since 00:00:00 UTC on January 1, 1970
parameters.help_zh: 查询开始时间点。该时间是指写入日志数据时指定的日志时间。 请求参数 from 和 to 定义的时间区间遵循左闭右开原则，即该时间区间包括区间开始时间点，但不包括区间结束时间点。如果 from 和 to 的值相同，则为无效区间，函数直接返回错误。 Unix 时间戳格式，表示从 1970-1-1 00:00:00 UTC 计算起的秒数
parameters.name: from

parameters.example: job: IT | select name, age, gender from log
parameters.name: query

parameters.help_en: The end of the query time range. This time is the log time specified when the log was written. The time range defined by the from and to parameters is left-inclusive and right-exclusive. This means the time range includes the start time but excludes the end time. If the from and to values are the same, the time range is invalid and the function returns an error. The value is a UNIX timestamp in seconds since 00:00:00 UTC on January 1, 1970
parameters.help_zh: 查询结束时间点。该时间是指写入日志数据时指定的日志时间。 请求参数 from 和 to 定义的时间区间遵循左闭右开原则，即该时间区间包括区间开始时间点，但不包括区间结束时间点。如果 from 和 to 的值相同，则为无效区间，函数直接返回错误。 Unix 时间戳格式，表示从 1970-1-1 00:00:00 UTC 计算起的秒数
parameters.name: to

schema.title_zh: 是否长链接。取值包括：  close：不是长链接，则每个HTTP请求都会重新建立TCP连接。 keep-alive：长链接，TCP连接建立后保持连接状态，节省连接所需时间和带宽。
